title: Canonicalize and validate DIS as link-local control traffic
description: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/transmit.rs send_dis emits the caller-provided unicast IPv6 destination unchanged, unlike send_dio, so a native or arbitrary same-IID prefix goes on wire despite the profile requiring link-local RPL control. receive-side dio_dis_destination_is_allowed accepts any non-multicast prefix sharing the local IID, and the raw DIS parser checks only the source IID suffix rather than canonical fe80::/64. Normalize unicast DIS destinations to canonical link-local, require canonical link-local source/destination (or ff02::1a where allowed), and add negative arbitrary-prefix tests.
